title: B2: Replace == Name == section headers with = Name
description: Update the section-header parsing rule in CooklangParser.swift (and/or Parser.swift) so that a line matching = <name> (exactly one leading =, a space, then the section name to end of line) opens a new section whose name is the captured text trimmed. The old == Name == syntax is dropped — lines starting with == become plain step text. All other section rules from spec 0001 are unchanged: implicit unnamed leading section for steps before the first = header, step numbering restarts at 1 in each named section, blank lines tolerated.
acceptance_criteria: = Name lines open a new section whose name is the captured text trimmed
== Name == lines are treated as plain step text — no section opened
Implicit unnamed leading section still works for steps before the first = header
Step numbering restarts at 1 in each named section (existing rule preserved)

handoff_summary.completed: Changed section-header detection from `== Name ==` to `= Name` in CooklangParser.swift:37-38. Build verified clean.
handoff_summary.risks: Existing tests that fixture `== Sauce ==` as a section header will now fail — they must be updated to use `= Sauce`. The tester agent should update those fixtures/assertions.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should run swift test, update any fixtures that used `== Name ==` syntax to `= Name`, and add/verify tests for: (1) `= Name` opens a section, (2) `== Name ==` is treated as plain step text, (3) implicit unnamed section still works, (4) step numbering resets per section.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Tests in CookbookCoreTests that assert `== Sauce ==` creates a named section will break — tester agent must update them.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `hasPrefix("= ")` (equals + space) rather than a regex. This is sufficient: a line starting with `= ` cannot start with `==` since the second character differs. Empty name after trimming (`= ` with no trailing text) falls through the `!inner.isEmpty` guard and is treated as plain step text.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests run per developer guardrails. Tester agent must cover: = Name → named section; == Name == → plain step; implicit section; step numbering reset.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Parser.swift was not modified — it handles inline step parsing only and has no section-header logic, so no changes were needed there.

conflict_risks: Tests in CookbookCoreTests that assert `== Sauce ==` creates a named section will break — tester agent must update them.

execution_history.summary: Updated CooklangParser.swift to use `= Name` section header syntax. Replaced `hasPrefix("==") && hasSuffix("==")` + `dropFirst(2).dropLast(2)` with `hasPrefix("= ")` + `dropFirst(2)`. The `"= "` prefix is mutually exclusive with `"=="` at the second character, so `== Name ==` lines naturally fall through to plain step text. Build passes.
